h1.font: - In order for a person to make a booking they must have a customer account. If a cleaner wanted to make a booking they would have to make a different customer account at this stage.

div.h1: - If a customer is not already logged in when they try to navigate to the booking page, they will be redirected to the sign in page upon clicking the booking buttons. They will then be redirected back to the booking page upon successfully signing in.
- If a cleaner tries to navigate to the booking page they will be redirected to their profile page/dashboard to see bookings that they can accept.
